process: Software review target: FR4 four copper layers, nominal 1.6mm, 1oz outer-copper annular criterion, CNC outline, ordinary plated through holes; original physical stackup/copper weight not verified.
profileScope: Explicit selected native software DFM constraints for an independent ESP32 review revision; not a complete factory rule deck, upstream process declaration or supplier acceptance.
notes: The original proposed profile and SHA remain retained; actual independent review derivations explicitly record which constraints changed from the modern template.
Original project MinViaDrill is via-only; ordinary vias remain at least 0.4mm and component PTH drills are represented separately.
The 0.25mm routed-edge policy is above the published 0.2mm CNC capability; the 0.3mm recommendation remains advisory, not an upstream 0.5mm source requirement.
Hole-to-copper stays 0.25mm; no severity or manufacturing-error exclusion is lowered to accept the repairs.
Material, copper weight, impedance, solder-mask and silk manufacturability, assembly access and supplier CAM review remain independent qualifications.

The primary capability table distinguishes multilayer 1oz PTH annular absolute minimum 0.15mm/recommended 0.20mm from the 2-layer 1oz 0.18mm/0.25mm figures; the actual non-thermal component-lead source lands are all at least 0.25mm.
Apply a 0.15mm native annular floor to every via/PTH, and enlarge all nine U4 exposed-pad thermal lands; no drill size or position is reduced to pass.
This is a selected review target, not a verified original laminate, copper weight, full supplier rule deck or manufacturing approval; native physical stackup is absent and remains unqualified.

exposedPadThermalHoleRole.datasheet: Microchip DS00002164B, page 6 exposed VSS pad must be grounded
